title: VOD: playing, controls up
note: The bar on the picture, no box: the title block top-left (the title treatment Home shows, the episode, what you’re getting), Ends at top-right; discs and pills over a scrim; the thumb has focus; the hint bar on the same scrim.

title: VOD: paused
note: OK pauses: the picture rests 35 % darker, the Play glyph comes back, Ends at gives way to a Paused tag and the minutes left (a clock that would drift), one line of the story. The controls never hide while paused; after 2 min they fade to 35 % for the OLED.

title: VOD: scrubbing
note: ▶ held: the row fades to 22 %, the bubble (chalk, ink) rides the thumb with the speed chip beside it; the played part follows the thumb; release seeks. No frame thumbnails: the provider’s streams carry no trick-play track (Research).

title: VOD: the buttons, Skip intro
note: ▲ lands on the Skip intro pill while its window is fresh (skip spec 3.3); ◀ ▶ move along the row, the focused button says what it is above itself (tvOS’s labelled transport bar), so the hint bar can stay short. The Slow Horses wordmark is grey on grey brick (under 3:1 against its own backdrop), so the text title stands in (v1.1 rule).

title: VOD: Up next at the credits
note: The credits started: Up next counts 15 s in its ring above the bar (its keys are not drawn while the controls are up). ▲ lands on Next episode while the card counts (v1.1, the fresh-Skip rule), so ▲ OK plays it; Back stays.

title: Live: the channel banner
note: No box: the same top block as a film. Number · logo · channel and the zap ring, the programme in Outfit 24, its times with the 4 dp progress, what’s next, subtitles and the replay days as words; the clock, 4K, HDR and LIVE at the right (v1.1: three facts, not five lozenges). The first 5 views: the hint bar on a 110 dp scrim. Gone after 4 s.

title: Live: zapping
note: ▲ pressed: the old picture dims at once, the zap card names the next channel and what’s on, the banner is already its (number, name, programme). Gone at the first frame, 600 ms at least.

title: Live: paused, behind live
note: ⏯ on a kept channel: the bar becomes the programme (21:00 to 23:50), the live point a red dot with LIVE beside it (the compact pill, inside the ends row) and the part not aired yet dashed; the banner drops its own LIVE (v1.1: one LIVE, where it is true); the picture rests 35 % darker as a paused film does; the corner says how far behind and when you paused (the replay days are already on the banner). Back to live leads the right group.

title: Replay: the timeline, shield on
note: Watch from tip-off while the game is still on: Score hidden and your own position top-right, never the live game’s; chapter ticks only up to the live point (Tip-off, Q2, Half, Q3; Q4 appears when it airs, OT only once played), Q2 lit, End hidden at the right, the live point 66 % along with the dashed part not aired yet. Skip to Q3 names where it goes. No score anywhere.

title: Replay: the game panel
note: The Game disc or Options › Game panel: the bar hides, the panel shows the score as aired at the moment you’re watching (90 s behind the picture, never ahead), Quarters with their aired times, only the ones aired so far (Q4 hasn’t started live: no row, as the bar has no tick; v1.1), OK jumps there, the one you’re in on surface-2; Plays to the moment, Sync. No box score until the buzzer + 2 min has played.

title: Options (a film)
note: ▼ from the bar: the controls hide, the panel floats at the left, first row focused (inset ring on surface-3, no scale). Rows name the value at the right; a missing track is a disabled row. Unchanged in behaviour; the tokens and spacing are the new bar’s.

title: VOD: the steady state (no hint bar)
note: After 5 views the hint bar retires (UI-SPEC 7): this is the screen he lives with. Two rows and the corner; the ends row has the bottom to itself.

title: Live: the banner, steady state
note: Once the hint bar has retired a zap draws the top block alone: no bottom scrim, nothing over the lower half of the broadcast (v1.1).

title: VOD: a near-white frame
note: The scrim’s test: a CC0 snow field (Wikimedia Commons, the brightest frame a film can throw). The title block on the heavier top scrim with the text shadow; the bar on the bottom scrim; measured in tools/contrast.js, every text passes 4.5:1 (SPEC 3).

title: Replay: over a bright court
note: The same timeline as 09 over a broadcast-like frame: bright hardwood across the bottom, the broadcaster’s own bug at the top. The scrims and the shadow carry the type; the LIVE pill, the lit chapter and the dot stay readable (measured, SPEC 3).
